meta.roomStandard: Private en-suite bathroom + Queen-size bed or larger (Queen or King) verified on official hotel property pages
meta.pricingWindowStandard: 7 nights, Mon Feb 15 – Mon Feb 22, 2027 (preferred window extended to 7 nights). Five consecutive 7-night windows across Feb 15 – Mar 22, 2027 also benchmarked.
meta.taxLawNote: NYC hotel rooms carry 14.75% combined sales & occupancy tax (8.875% NYS/NYC/MCTD sales tax + 5.875% NYC Hotel Room Occupancy Tax) plus $3.50–$4.00/night flat unit/occupancy fees ($1.50 NYS unit fee + $2.00 NYC fee on rooms >=$40 + optional $0.50–$6.00 BID/destination assessment). Source: https://alpha.nyc.gov/site/finance/taxes/business-hotel-room-occupancy-tax.page
meta.transitRankingFinding: All 5 transit-timed Manhattan hotels reach 100% of the 5 major NYC Michelin clusters (66 of 69 starred restaurants and ~346 of 369 total Michelin-listed venues across Manhattan & North Brooklyn) in <=37 minutes via MTA subway/bus/ferry (Google Maps transit matrix captured 2026-11-25 17:14–17:31 ET). Because <=60 minutes does not separate central/lower Manhattan hotels on cluster count, secondary tie-breakers are: (1) average transit minutes across the 5 Michelin anchors, (2) verified 7-night all-in total price for 2 adults, and (3) cancellation flexibility & amenities.

bookingTimingAnalysis.cheapestStayDates: Mon Feb 15 – Mon Feb 22, 2027 ($848 pre-tax / ~$998 all-in at Eurostars Wall Street non-refundable; $943 pre-tax / $1,110 all-in at DoubleTree Chelsea with free cancellation)
bookingTimingAnalysis.whenToBookRecommendation: Lock a FREE-CANCELLATION rate immediately (late Nov 2026) while property-declared 'Black Friday Deals' (30%–39% off at DoubleTree Chelsea and Arlo NoMad) are active, then re-shop after the Dec 14, 2026 Michelin ceremony and 14–30 days prior to arrival (early Feb 2027). Do NOT lock non-refundable rates until flight times and duration (3 vs 7 vs 14 nights) are finalized.
bookingTimingAnalysis.evidenceNote: Official hotel brand widgets vary in advance horizon (Michelin's widget caps at 31 days; Hyatt/Hilton/Booking open ~11–12 months out). No official source guarantees a future price drop, so holding a $0-prepayment cancellable rate caps upside risk while preserving downside re-pricing.
